title: Channel Video Catalog
description: video_bank/channel_catalogs/<channel_id>.json, written by scripts/sync_catalogs.py. One file per allowlisted channel, its full upload list, refreshed occasionally (not per batch). 06_video_candidates searches these first instead of spending YouTube search quota. The cheap flat listing has no description or date; full metadata is fetched only for real candidates, by 07_transcript_sync.
